LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitPod.label: snaring lure
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitPod.description: Grows an edible sprout that attracts hungry wild animals. When an animal starts feeding, the lure seizes it with tendrils. Capture requires a free slot in the shared grasping tendril system.
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitSprout.label: flesh bait sprout
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitSprout.description: An edible sprout grown by a snaring lure. Lures hungry wild animals within reach of its grasping tendrils.
